name: Availability-surprise totals
thesis: Late upgrades and downgrades that the market has not fully absorbed show up in the total before they show up in the spread
entry_rule: Bet only when the designation surprise exceeds the historical noise floor for that position group
stake_rule: fractional Kelly at one quarter scale against our own model error (SIG-18)

name: Quarterback chain change
thesis: A confirmed change of quarterback is the largest single availability event per week and is under-reacted in the half-point economy
entry_rule: Bet the side implied by the change when the change is verified from official reporting on or before the decision timestamp
stake_rule: half-Kelly with a hard cap per game
n_target: 400 plus two full seasons of elapsed time

name: Depth-gap pass-catchers
thesis: When a starting tackle or lead rusher is out, the pass volume of the opposing slot and the team's check-down men both shift; only the side we can project gets bet
entry_rule: Over on the receiving prop of the target-share beneficiary when the deficiency gap exceeds the threshold
stake_rule: flat one unit until the sample exists

name: Short-week fatigue
thesis: A club playing Thursday after Sunday, or Monday after Thursday, is shaded on late-game efficiency; the fixture fact is free and verifiable
entry_rule: Under on the short-week club's team total when rest delta is at least three days behind the opponent
gates_blocking: none on inputs; G-07 on pricing

name: Own-line residual
thesis: We originate a number, publish the residual against a multi-book consensus, and bet only the residuals whose interval excludes zero
entry_rule: Bet when residual exceeds vig plus k times model error
stake_rule: fractional Kelly on the residual's own interval

name: Two-leg availability stack
market: two correlated singles from the same game
thesis: A pair of legs whose outcomes share a cause is worth more than the product of its parts if the operator priced it as independent
entry_rule: Bet only when the offered parlay price exceeds our joint estimate by more than the sum of the individual edges
stake_rule: half the stake of the equivalent two-single ticket
correlation_treatment: explicit joint estimate; independence baseline shown for contrast only

name: Cross-game parlay discipline
thesis: Cross-game parlays are the product where a bettor pays the most per unit of true probability; the strategy is mostly to decline, and to bet only the rare repriced case
entry_rule: Bet only when a promo or a mis-set parlay price beats our joint estimate
stake_rule: no Kelly on promos; one unit maximum
correlation_treatment: assumed independence for the joint, which is the conservative direction

name: Same-game QB/WR stack
thesis: Both legs are driven by the same play sequences; the positive coupling is structural and the operator prices it, so the edge must come from our conditioning, not from ignoring the coupling
entry_rule: Bet the combo only if our conditioned joint probability exceeds the offered price after the correlation adjustment
correlation_treatment: conditioned on our own game-total distribution

name: Teammate negation pair
market: two receivers on the same team
thesis: Targets are a budget: one receiver's share is subtracted from the other's, net of volume growth, which is the least-priced correlation in the market
entry_rule: Bet the pair when the offered joint price implies near-independence while our volume model implies meaningful negative coupling
correlation_treatment: negative coupling from the target-budget constraint

name: Rush/reception volume coupling
market: rush yards plus receptions for one back
thesis: A workhorse back's two props are positively coupled by snaps and involvement but negatively coupled by play-action mix; the net sign must be measured, not assumed
entry_rule: Measure first; no bet rule until the fitted sign is stable
correlation_treatment: fit the residual correlation after conditioning on game script

name: Deficiency-driven alternate lines
thesis: When a secondary is missing two starters, the market adjusts the main line but the alternate market reprices more slowly
entry_rule: Bet the alternate whose repricing lag exceeds a fixed window after the designation

name: Do-nothing control
thesis: A deliberately inert entry that never bets, so the leaderboard can measure whether any signal beats doing nothing after vig

name: Public-news echo control
thesis: A negative control: bet in the direction of publicly reported news immediately. If this entry profits, our signals add nothing the market does not also see
entry_rule: bet the direction of the headline

name: Late-window origination
thesis: Restrict entries to the window after the last public filing and before kickoff, to test whether our edge is information or noise
entry_rule: Bet only inside the late window and compare the residual distribution against the early window

name: Availability-differential lean, hash-locked
market: game spread, against our own published number
thesis: Our number is built from points scored and allowed through week 9, so it cannot see who is playing this week. When one club's availability load - designated out plus did not practise - is at least four players heavier than the opponent's, the depleted club is being over-valued by exactly the amount our model is blind to, and the healthier side is the lean
signals: SIG-01, SIG-02 (club-level: the availability load columns in data/club_availability_20261113_66faefac.csv)
entry_rule: Evaluate once per week on the most recent official hub read; act only when the load differential is >= 4 players; a fixture inside the threshold is recorded as a no-call, not skipped
stake_rule: no stake. G-01 (entitlement) and G-07 (vig and cost accounting) are not passed, so the ledger records direction and error only
correlation_treatment: n/a - single leg, one per fixture, no same-game stacking
n_target: 400 settled fixtures (G-08); the sample-size table on this site says a 1.0-point error difference needs 1,382 spreads, so a 13-fixture slate is a start and not a result
